item.title: Damaged bollard – corner of 52 Harvest Street, 4th September
item.description:
A bollard on the corner of 52 Harvest Street has been damaged by a van being used by contractors carrying out gardening work at a neighbouring property. The bollard appears to have been knocked/broken and is no longer functioning as intended. The contractors have wrapped black tape around it, but this is clearly only a temporary measure and does not properly secure or repair the damage. I have photographs showing the current condition of the bollard and would be grateful if this could be inspected and repaired as soon as possible, particularly as it is positioned on a street corner and may present a safety issue.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 17, New Barn Avenue, Lynworth, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
